name: exists_elementarySubstructure_card_eq
statement: Set M) (κ : Cardinal.{w'}) (h1 : ℵ₀ ≤ κ) (h2 : Cardinal.lift.{w'} #s ≤ Cardinal.lift.{w} κ) (h3 : Cardinal.lift.{w'} L.card ≤ Cardinal.lift.{max u v} κ) (h4 : Cardinal.lift.{w} κ ≤ Cardinal.lift.{w'} #M) : ∃ S : L.ElementarySubstructure M, s ⊆ S ∧ Cardinal.lift.{w'} #S = Cardinal.lift.{w} κ
